session_note: Montana's Legislature is biennial and convenes in regular session only in odd years; the 69th Legislature's 2025 Regular Session ran 2025-01-06 to sine die 2025-04-30, and there is no 2026 regular session. Montana's own bill-tracking backend (bearbeta.legmt.gov, which powers the public bills.legmt.gov 'Bill Explorer') lists only two sessions in its current-era registry: sessionId 2 = 2025 Regular Session (69th Legislature, sine die 2025-04-30) and sessionId 3 = 2027 Regular Session (70th Legislature, convening 2027-01-04, the only session currently flagged active/upcoming). No 2025 or 2026 special session is registered in that system. WebSearch was unavailable for this task (session search quota exhausted before this state's research began), so the special-session check relied on the state's own session registry plus a WordPress news-feed query on legmt.gov (that feed has not been updated since March 2024, so it is not strong independent evidence either way) rather than an open web search; no evidence of a 2025 or 2026 special session was found. All 6 bills below reached their final 2025 disposition in the regular session and nothing has changed since the packet's capture.
